jobs.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Create ONE production character sprite atlas for the existing Chinese Song-dynasty RTS hero Song Jiang, using the attached image strictly as his identity, clothes, weapon and painted game-art reference.
Output an actual RGBA PNG on a TRANSPARENT background. All empty space must have alpha=0. No rendered checkerboard, no gray/white/black canvas, no background layer, no floor, no cast ground shadow, no glow or border. Keep just the four figures.
Layout: a square atlas with exactly FOUR equal square cells, 2 columns by 2 rows. No lines or labels. Each cell contains one full-body standing idle pose of the SAME man at identical scale. Keep every figure and sword inside its own cell with generous clear margins, and both soles near 82% of cell height.
Camera fixed at about 30 degrees down for a 2:1 isometric RTS.
Top-left cell: facing southeast / down-right, FRONT and rightward facing clearly visible.
Top-right cell: facing southwest / down-left, FRONT and leftward facing clearly visible.
Bottom-left cell: facing northeast / up-right, BACK of head and back of robe visible, face mostly hidden.
Bottom-right cell: facing northwest / up-left, BACK of head and back of robe visible, face mostly hidden.
These are four genuine rotated views, not repeated front views. Rotate head, chest, pelvis, knees and boots consistently. Never merely mirror the sprite: preserve his anatomical right hand holding his straight silver Chinese sword in every view, and left hand empty.
Identity lock: adult stocky Chinese man, black beard and moustache, long black hair tied in topknot with small gold crown, ornate ochre-gold long robe with dark brocade borders, black draped scarf around shoulders, dark belt with round gold fittings and muted teal sash at the hip, dark trousers and black boots with gold trim. Keep the same costume construction and ornaments, not a new emperor, no armor, no horse.
Sword lowered in a relaxed ready idle stance. Similar restrained hand-painted historical RTS detail to the reference, strong silhouette at small game scale. Soft upper-left lighting consistent across the atlas. No extra weapons, no symbols, no text, no UI, no scenery.

Edit target: the attached four-view Song Jiang sprite atlas. Keep the 2 by 2 layout, the same four camera/body directions, same face, gold robe, black shoulder scarf, belt, boots and crown, same painted style and figure scale.
Correct the mistaken mirrored handedness in the RIGHT COLUMN ONLY. In the top-right FRONT-facing-left figure, move the sword into his anatomical RIGHT hand (the hand on the LEFT side of that figure on the page); his other hand must be empty. Put his teal hip sash on the RIGHT side of the front-facing figure, the same anatomical side as the top-left view. In the bottom-right BACK-facing-left figure, move the sword into his anatomical RIGHT hand (the hand on the RIGHT side of that figure on the page); the left hand must be empty, and teal sash stays on his anatomical LEFT hip. Do NOT flip either entire figure: keep him looking left, including his head, torso and feet.
Preserve the LEFT COLUMN poses and handedness.
Also remove ALL of the painted checkerboard behind and around the four figures and all background. Output a square PNG with a genuinely transparent alpha channel around every silhouette, including between limbs and swords. Do NOT paint a checkerboard or a solid-color background; the actual output alpha must be zero there. Keep complete figures and swords inside their own cells with clear padding, no clipping. No text, labels, borders, floor, ground shadow, UI or extra objects. This is a production character atlas intended for direct compositing onto an RTS terrain map.

Edit the attached existing game character into ONE northwest-facing sprite: rotate the same man to show his BACK, facing toward the upper-left corner of the page. Show the back of his head, black shoulder scarf and ochre-gold brocade robe, with only a sliver of his left cheek. His black boots also point toward upper-left. Keep his original gold crown, tied black hair, gold belt, left-hip teal sash, black boots, realistic proportions and hand-painted historical RTS style. Keep the straight silver Chinese sword in his anatomical RIGHT hand; in this BACK view that sword-bearing hand is on the RIGHT side of the figure on the page. The other hand is empty. Full body, relaxed ready standing pose, fixed elevated 30 degree game camera, no horse, no armor.
Remove ALL background and the old gray ground shadow. Output a square PNG with a genuinely transparent alpha channel around the silhouette, including between the sword, robe and legs. Do NOT paint a checkerboard or a solid-color background; the actual output alpha must be zero there. Center the entire intact character with generous transparent padding, no clipping. No text, labels, borders, floor, shadow plane, other people, or additional props. This is a production sprite intended to be composited directly onto an RTS terrain map.
